_comment: Merge these rules into your existing Firebase Realtime Database Security Rules.
_instructions: 1. Open Firebase Console → Realtime Database → Rules
2. Inside the 'melody-miracle' object in your existing rules, add the 'config' and 'access_requests' blocks below.
4. In the Firebase console, manually set 'melody-miracle/config/github_pat' to your GitHub PAT string.
(or use the 'Share this token with allowed users' button in the app after setting up your local PAT).
5. Users will appear in 'melody-miracle/access_requests/<uid>' when they click 'Request access' in Settings.
Use the Access Management section in Settings to grant them access.
